title: Model profile entry
description: One profile's value in /config/profiles.json (the 'profile' state document, an object keyed by profile name). Every field is top-level. A profile points a named model choice at a saved provider connection and deployment; agents, routines and the knowledge indexer refer to it by name.

description.description: What this profile is for, shown on the Profiles page. Trimmed; omit instead of leaving it blank.

provider_id.description: Id of a saved provider connection (Providers page). Must exist when the profile is used.

deployment.description: The model or deployment name on that provider (labelled 'Model' in the UI), e.g. 'gpt-5-mini'.

context_window.description: The model's context window in tokens. Omit when unknown.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long the provider keeps a prompt cache, in seconds. Omit when unknown.

reasoning_enabled.description: Force reasoning on or off. Omit to inherit the model's default.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort, e.g. 'low', 'medium', 'high'. Omit to inherit.

reasoning_summary.description: Reasoning summary mode, e.g. 'auto', 'concise', 'detailed'. Omit to inherit.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the rates, e.g. 'USD'. Pricing is all four fields or none; none means unpriced.

input_per_million.description: Estimated cost per 1M input tokens as a decimal string, e.g. '0.25'. Zero is valid.

cached_input_per_million.description: Estimated cost per 1M cached input tokens as a decimal string, e.g. '0.025'.

output_per_million.description: Estimated cost per 1M output tokens as a decimal string, e.g. '2.00'.
